item.title: Republicans Return to Tough-on-Crime Message Ahead of Midterms
item.description: Republicans are emphasizing crime and public disorder in midterm campaigns, as voters express frustration over the cost of living...

item.title: Jim Bakker, televangelism empire builder, dies at 86
item.description: Jim Bakker and his first wife Tammy Faye created an evangelical empire through the hit TV show 'The PTL Club,' but later lost it.

item.title: Climate change case reaches Supreme Court
item.description: The Supreme Court is reviewing a major lawsuit by Boulder, Colo., against Exxon Mobil and Suncor Energy seeking damages for climate impacts.

item.title: Trump says Iran could 'take out' Los Angeles and San Diego
item.description: At a Nebraska rally, President Donald Trump suggested Iran could 'take out' Los Angeles and San Diego, drawing attention.
